title: Isolation and phenotypic characterization of human and nonhuman primate intestinal lamina propria mononuclear cells
protocol: Process intestinal tissues within 2 hours after collection to avoid major cellular damage.
Store tissue in TS if not processed immediately, keeping TS on ice during storage.
Transport colonic tissues in sterile containers filled with cold TS; adjust volume based on tissue size.
Digest colonic tissue enzymatically to obtain a single cell suspension of LPMCs.
Remove the tissue from the TS.
Identify different portions of the intestine.
Place the intestine in a 150 mm × 15 mm Petri dish containing 30 mL of TS.
Dissect the sigmoid colon from the rest of the large intestine.
Place the dissected sigmoid colon inside a 100 mm × 20 mm Petri dish with 10 mL of TS.
Remove external fat using sterile forceps (Figure 2C).
Carefully open the intestinal tube to expose the luminal side (Figure 2D).
View the mucosa from the luminal side (Figure 2E).
Remove fecal material by gently washing the tissue with TS.
Transfer the tissue to a new Petri dish filled with 10 mL of TS.
Repeat the washing steps until the fecal material is completely removed.
Using scissors and forceps, carefully remove the muscular layer without cutting the mucosae.
Cut the tissue into two sections no greater than 3 × 4 cm (12 cm²).
Transfer each section to a 50 mL Falcon tube pre-filled with 25 mL of pre-digestion solution.
Cut the tissue into two portions of 12 cm².
Transfer each portion to a Falcon tube pre-filled with digestion solution.
Incubate the tubes at 37°C for 20 min in a shaking incubator.
After enzymatic digestion, wash the tissue with 10 mL of 1× PBS.
Transfer the washed tissue to a 50 mL Falcon tube pre-filled with 25 mL of pre-digestion solution.
Incubate the tube at 37°C for 20 min in a shaking incubator.
Using forceps, collect the tissue and place it inside a Petri dish.
Wash the collected tissue with 10 mL of 1× PBS.
Wash the tissue again with 10 mL of HBSS+Ca/+Mg.
Dissect each 12 cm² tissue portion into small pieces no greater than 0.5 × 0.5 cm using scissors and forceps.
Transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube filled with 25 mL of pre-warmed enzyme digestion solution.
Incubate at 37°C for 60 min inside a shaking incubator.
Place a 70-μm cell strainer on top of a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Vortex the tube containing the digested tissue.
Filter the solution through the cell strainer.
Transfer undigested tissue to a Falcon tube filled with enzyme digestion solution.
Add 25 mL of wash buffer to the 25 mL of LPMCs-containing solution.
Centrifuge the mixture at 500 g for 10 min, maintaining a temperature between 18°C and 25°C.
Discard the supernatant using a 25 mL pipette.
Resuspend the LPMCs-containing pellet in 1 mL of wash buffer using a 1 mL pipette.
Transfer the resuspended mixture to a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add 49 mL of wash buffer to the Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 500 g for 10 min, maintaining a temperature between 18°C and 25°C.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant using a 25 mL serological pipette without disturbing the LPMCs pellet.
Resuspend the LPMCs-containing pellet in 10 mL of wash buffer.
Transfer any undigested residual tissue from the cell strainer to a new 50 mL Falcon tube containing 25 mL of digestion solution.
Incubate the mixture for 30 min at 37°C inside a shaking incubator.
Repeat steps involving centrifugation, supernatant discard, resuspension in wash buffer, and transfer to a new Falcon tube.
Keep the LPMCs obtained after the first enzymatic digestion on ice or at 4°C while completing the second enzymatic digestion of the tissue.
Perform the first enzymatic digestion for 60 minutes.
Perform the second enzymatic digestion for 30 minutes.
Add LPMCs obtained after the second digestion to those obtained after the first digestion.
Resuspend cells in RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 10% FCS and 1% PSN.
Count the cells using an automated cell counter or trypan blue staining followed by hemocytometer counting.
Use LPMCs immediately for culture or proceed to cryopreservation.
For cryopreservation, resuspend LPMC pellet in freezing media.
Aliquot 1 ml of cell suspension per cryovial.
Place cryovials into a freezing container and transfer to -80°C freezer.
Transfer cryovials to liquid nitrogen after 24 hours.
Pre-cool centrifuge to 4°C.
Prepare a viability dye solution in 1× PBS at a suitable concentration.
Reconstitute Fixable Dead Cell Stain in 50 mL of DMSO as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Aliquot the reconstituted stain and store at -20°C protected from light.
Prepare an intermediate dilution by adding 1 μL of reconstituted stain to 300 μL of 1× PBS.
Use 10 μL of the intermediate dilution to prepare 100 μL of antibody master mix as described in Tables 4 and 5.
Prepare FACS buffer by supplementing 1× PBS with 2%–5% FCS and 2.5 mM EDTA.
Prepare an antibody master mix to stain cells of interest.
Titrate antibody concentrations according to the volume of 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Add an extra 1–2 samples to the master mix to account for pipetting error.
Adjust cell concentration to 1–4 × 10^6 LPMCs per 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Transfer adjusted cells to a 96 well U-bottom tissue culture treated plate.
Prepare an unstained control and fluorescence minus one (FMO) controls.
Do not add any antibodies to the unstained control.
Ensure that the FMO cell concentration is the same as that of the sample concentration.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 g at 4°C for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant using a multi-channel pipette without disturbing the cell pellet.
Alternatively, remove the supernatant by flipping the plate.
Prepare “saturation solution” by supplementing 1× PBS with 5% macaque serum or 5% FCS as needed.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 100 μL of saturation solution per well.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 500 g at 4°C for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μL of antibody master mix prepared in step 25.
Incubate cells for 15 min at 4°C.
Cover the plate with aluminum foil to protect from light.
Add 150 μL of 1× PBS to each well.
Centrifuge at 500 g at 4°C for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and repeat step 31 (resuspend cells in antibody master mix).
Optional: Incubate cells with 200 μL of 1× BD FACS lysing solution for 5 minutes if high RBC contamination is observed.
Wash twice with 200 μL of 1× PBS after lysis step.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL of BD Cytofix buffer per well.
Pipette up and down several times to ensure a single cell suspension.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C protected from light.
Note: A solution of 1%–4% PFA can be used for fixation as an alternative method.
Add 100 μL of 1× PBS to each well.
Centrifuge the samples at 500 g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from each well.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL of 1× PBS.
Transfer cells into a 5 mL FACS tube for acquisition on a flow cytometer.
Add 100–200 μL of 1× PBS to samples according to the number of cells being stained.
Store samples at 4°C protected from light if running them the following day.
Collect data using a BD LSRFortessa or Beckman Coulter NaviosEx flow cytometer.
Analyze the collected data with FlowJo software.
